# Browser contracts for the CI job `contracts` (hacs M45/D12), run by .github/workflows/validate.yml with
# --network none in the pinned Playwright image. Only repo scripts without private data and without network.
# One script per line, relative to the repo root; {bundle} = dist/<bundle>.js, {out} = a fresh output folder.
# render.py runs without regeln.py (rules 1 and 2 then stay unmeasured, the card and editor checks still count).
# Not listed: layout-dialog-contract.py (native HA frontend, private access file).
docs/render/render.py {bundle} {out}
docs/render/visual_contract.py {bundle} {out}
